scalePolicy: At each textScale, snapshot all HTML element computed font sizes before changing any ancestor/child styles; multiply HTML text and line-height only. SVG root and SVG text/tspan computed font sizes remain at their Mermaid-rendered baseline, so chart-defined font sizes and SVG coordinate geometry are unchanged. CSS pixels, deviceScaleFactor 1.
